title: The Pilgrims of the Rhine
author: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron
description: "The Pilgrims of the Rhine" by Edward Bulwer Lytton is a romantic novel written during the early 19th century.
longDescription: The book features both enchanted fairy characters, such as Queen Nymphalin, and mortal protagonists like Trevylyan and Gertrude, whose intertwined fates lead them on a journey along the Rhine River.

authorInfo.bio: Lytton, Edward Bulwer Lytton, Baron (1803–1873) is the author of Rienzi, the Last of the Roman Tribunes. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
